text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 6, 2025) for 376 Brunswick Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Amended the By-law column of Items 2 and 11 of the Property Standards Order (May 6, 2025) for 376 Brunswick Avenue, Folder Number 25 152213 PRS 00 IV by removing "36.D." and replacing it with "36.F.". 2. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 6, 2025) for 376 Brunswick Avenue, Folder Number 25 152213 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 19, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
